name: Chicago masonry restoration & tuckpointing for 2-6 flats, small condo associations and property-managed buildings (North/Northwest Side first)
summary: Customer unit = one masonry job (tuckpointing, lintel/parapet/chimney repair) modelled as one-time revenue per new customer; recurring revenue is zero. Past customers form a referral pool that decays (churn). The founder sells, estimates, handles permits and runs the business; the City licence requires a hired supervising mason (City exam, 21+) and all mason work by W-2 employees, so crew units of two W-2 workers are added as revenue grows (first unit includes the supervising mason). Seasonality (Dec-Feb ~10% of permits) is averaged; crew cost is a blended 10.5-month equivalent.
evidence_notes: Licensing: Chicago mason contractor licence $150 (+$150 exam) requires employing a supervising mason who passed the City written exam (age 21+); work only by the licensee's employees (UI, WC and income-tax employees), never 1099 contractors; licence auto-inactivates without a supervising mason [A, DB-S003].

Demand: express masonry permits 1,964 (2024), 1,924 (2025), 1,873 (2026 to 28 Nov); median reported cost $15,000 (2024-25) and $16,200 (2026); IQR 2025 $7,500-$39,900 [A, DB-S001] (applicant-reported cost). Median 400 sq ft; median $54/sq ft for 100-499 sq ft jobs, $27.50 for 500-1,499, $13 for 1,500-4,999 (cost per sq ft includes lintels/rebuild work) [A, DB-S001].
Condo/association-owned buildings: 661 of 5,767 express masonry permits 2024-26 (11.5%) with median reported cost $48,550 - about 3x the overall median [A, DB-S001].

Violations: 6,572 exterior-wall/parapet/chimney violations dated 2025-26 at 4,216 addresses; 3,722 addresses still OPEN; only 250 of those addresses had an express masonry permit in 2024-26 [A, DB-S002] - a large unserved, identifiable need (some owners will use unpermitted or non-masonry fixes).
Competition: 350 distinct mason contractors on 2025 permits; top firm 86 permits (~4.5%) [A, DB-S001].

Labour: Cook County prevailing (union-scale) brick mason $54.81/h + $14.74 H/W + $25.51 pension + $1.59 training = $96.65/h package; laborer $53.00 + $19.86 + $18.34 + $0.91 = $92.11/h [A, DB-S004] - applies to public work and union shops. BLS brickmasons Chicago MSA annual mean $84,010 (2025) [C, DB-S005]. Private residential tuckpointing is mostly non-union (E).

Workers' comp: Illinois class-5022 rate MISSING; neighbouring Missouri NCCI advisory loss cost for 5022 = $4.143 per $100 payroll effective 2026-01-01 [C proxy, DB-S006]; with carrier loss-cost multipliers and Illinois benefit levels we assume $7-10 per $100 (E). Insureon masonry medians (tiny firms): GL $88/mo, WC $213/mo, auto $268/mo [D, DB-S007] - too small for a W-2 crew.
Job costs, win rates, crew productivity (35-45 jobs/crew-season) are E.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Recruit supervising mason who holds or passes the City exam via Continental Testing Services, licence $150 [A, DB-S003]; GL/WC binding, truck and scaffold (E for time).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: 2-8 weeks for owners; 2-6 months for condo boards (Stage A/C, E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Estimate requests from violation-address mailers, PM referrals, Google LSA; 3,722 open masonry-violation addresses [A, DB-S002]. Volume E. Optimistic capped so year-3 job volume stays near the busiest 2025 Chicago permit holder (86 express permits [A, DB-S001]).
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Owners take 2-4 bids (E); 350 permit-holding competitors [A, DB-S001].
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Past-customer and PM repeat/referral work (portfolio managers pulled 8-17 masonry permits each 2024-26 [A, DB-S001]); rate E; masonry is an occasional purchase (pointing every 20-30 years), so referral rates are set low.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Decay of the past-customer referral pool (no recurring revenue modelled).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Median express masonry permit reported cost $15,000-$16,200 [A, DB-S001]; mix shifted toward small condo associations (median $48,550) lifts the mean; reported costs are applicant-stated and may understate price (E).
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Direct non-labour costs: materials, scaffold/lift rental, permits (median express fee $375 [A, DB-S001]), dumpster, silica controls ~20-28% (Stage C used 17%, E). Census NAICS 238 materials 30.4% of receipts incl. material-heavy trades [C, WS10-S022]. Crew labour is in Staff. Illinois masonry firms with 5-19 employees take in ~$232-242k receipts per employee with payroll ~$71-86k per employee [C, DB-S036].
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Estimating time is founder's; mailers, LSA leads, drone/photo surveys spread over ~2 bids per job won... (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Deposit + progress payments for residential (Home Repair Act formalities over $1,000 [A, WS18-S011]); condo boards pay slower (E).
drivers.dpo_days__source: Supply-house trade credit after 3-6 months of history (assumed; terms MISSING).
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Small trade contractors sell at low SDE multiples (BizBuySell-type D evidence not retrieved) (E).

staff.role: Mason crew unit: 2 W-2 workers (supervising mason or foreman + mason/tender), non-union
staff.notes: Crew count = ceil(prior-month revenue / $40k), i.e. ~$480k/yr per 2-person crew (~27 median jobs) (E). Wages ~$88k supervising mason/foreman + ~$60k mason/tender = ~$148k (BLS brickmason mean $84,010 [C, DB-S005]); burden ~30% incl. WC 5022 at assumed $7-10/$100 [E; MO loss cost $4.143, DB-S006] = ~$192k/yr, blended to ~$15.5k/mo for winter layoffs. First unit must include the City-exam supervising mason [A, DB-S003]. Union packages would be ~$96.65/h mason, ~$92.11/h laborer [A, DB-S004].

overhead.notes: Premium MISSING; Insureon tiny-firm median GL $88/mo + umbrella $93/mo [D, DB-S007] is far below a 3-person exterior-height crew; E.
Insureon auto median $268/mo [D, DB-S007]; fuel/maintenance E.
